description.value: One Cafe (正斗茶記 in Cantonese) is a Chinese fast food café situated inside a unit at 4380 Number 3 Road in Richmond's busy commercial corridor. The Cantonese name 正斗茶記 is associated with a Hong Kong-style café format, suggesting a local and culturally distinct dining experience. The business was field-checked and confirmed open as recently as February 2026.
